code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the repeated horizontal color strip (the palette).
    from collections import Counter
    nonempty = [tuple(row) for row in grid if any(row)]
    repeated = Counter(nonempty).most_common(1)[0][0]
    palette = [v for v in repeated if v]
    # The source is the largest connected component, excluding the palette strip.
    palette_rows = {r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if tuple(row) == repeated}
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v}
    components = []
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
                    for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
                if not any(y in palette_rows for y,x in pts): components.append((pts,color))
    pts,color=max(components,key=lambda z:len(z[0]))
    r0=min(y for y,x in pts); r1=max(y for y,x in pts); c0=min(x for y,x in pts)
    shape={(y-r0,x-c0) for y,x in pts}; bh=r1-r0+1
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    start=h-len(palette)*bh
    for i,col in enumerate(palette):
        for dy,dx in shape:
            y=start+i*bh+dy; x=c0+dx
            if 0<=y<h: out[y][x]=col
    return out
'''
